export type ActionAudience = "user" | "agent" | "workflow" | "mcp" | "plugin";

export type ActionAvailability = {
    readonly available: true;
} | {
    readonly available: false;
    readonly code: string;
    readonly reason: string;
    readonly kind?: ActionErrorKind;
};

export interface ActionCallContext extends ActionCallOrigin {
    readonly actor_id: string;
    readonly memory_read_mode?: "explicit" | "task";
    readonly memory_operation_id?: string;
    readonly assistant_reply?: import("@molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/services/assistant").AssistantReplyDelivery;
    readonly page_context?: {
        readonly url: string | null;
        readonly title: string | null;
        readonly provenance: "host_snapshot" | "client_reported";
    };
    readonly locale?: ActionLocale;
    readonly audit_actor_id?: string;
    readonly delegated_by?: string;
    readonly delegated_audience?: ActionAudience;
    readonly runtime_session_id?: string;
    readonly runtime_session_missing?: true;
    readonly actor_kind?: "user" | "runtime" | null;
    readonly user_action?: ActionUserAction;
    readonly project_id: string | null;
    readonly audience: ActionAudience;
    readonly readable_project_ids?: readonly string[];
    readonly calling_plugin_id?: string;
    readonly plugin_install_id?: string;
    readonly host_plugin?: import("@molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/app-host").HostPluginCaller;
    readonly original_file?: HostOfferedOriginalFile;
    readonly original_input?: HostOfferedOriginalInput;
    readonly query_only?: true;
    readonly read_only_effects?: true;
    readonly permissions: readonly string[];
    readonly allowed_capability_ids?: readonly string[];
    readonly allowed_actions?: readonly ActionReference[];
    readonly validate_authority?: (reference: ActionReference) => void | Promise<void>;
    readonly assert_authority_current?: (reference?: ActionReference, requiredPermissions?: readonly string[]) => void;
    readonly validate_permissions?: (permissions: readonly string[]) => void | Promise<void>;
    readonly signal?: AbortSignal;
    readonly retain_background_authority?: (references: readonly ActionReference[], additionalPermissions?: readonly string[]) => RetainedActionAuthority;
    readonly on_progress?: (event: {
        readonly stage: string;
        readonly progress: number;
        readonly text_delta?: string;
    }) => void;
    readonly scene_binding?: {
        readonly scene_id: string;
        readonly binding_id: string;
    };
}

export interface ActionCallOrigin {
    readonly call_id?: string;
}

export interface ActionClient {
    discover(context: ActionCallContext): readonly ActionView[] | Promise<readonly ActionView[]>;
    invoke(context: ActionCallContext, reference: ActionReference, input: unknown): Promise<unknown>;
}

export interface ActionDefinition<Input = unknown, Output = unknown> extends HostCapabilityDescriptor {
    readonly __types__?: {
        input: Input;
        output: Output;
    };
    readonly operation: "query" | "command";
    readonly provider_id?: string;
    readonly action: ActionMetadata;
}

export declare class ActionError extends Error {
    readonly code: string;
    readonly kind?: ActionErrorKind;
    readonly details?: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
    constructor(code: string, message: string, options?: ActionErrorOptions);
}

export type ActionErrorKind = (typeof ACTION_ERROR_KIND_NAMES)[number];

export interface ActionErrorOptions {
    readonly kind?: ActionErrorKind;
    readonly details?: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
    readonly cause?: unknown;
}

export interface ActionExecutionContext extends ActionCallContext {
    readonly beforeEffect: () => Promise<void>;
    readonly current_action?: ExactActionReference;
    readonly retainAuthority?: (references: readonly ActionReference[], options?: {
        readonly audience?: "workflow";
    }) => RetainedActionAuthority;
    readonly retainBackgroundAuthority?: (additionalPermissions?: readonly string[]) => RetainedActionAuthority;
}

export interface ActionExecutionPolicy {
    readonly timeout_ms?: number;
    readonly cost?: "none" | "metered" | "unknown";
    readonly max_calls_per_minute?: number;
}

}

export interface ActionMetadata {
    readonly title: string;
    readonly description: string;
    readonly local_id?: string;
    readonly kind: "query" | "judgment" | "operation" | "navigation";
    readonly scope: "home" | "project";
    readonly effect?: "read" | "write" | "irreversible";
    readonly plugin?: false;
    readonly scheduling?: "concurrent";
    readonly authorship?: "session";

    readonly audiences: readonly ActionAudience[];
    readonly permissions: readonly string[];

    readonly output_schema?: ActionSchema;
    readonly result_view?: ActionResultView;
    readonly input_type?: string;
    readonly output_type?: string;
    readonly workflow_content?: WorkflowContentStation;
    readonly search_source?: SearchSourceDeclaration;
    readonly file_source?: FileSourceDeclaration;

        readonly role: "context" | "reply";
        readonly subject_kind: string;
    };
    readonly home_aggregate?: true;
    readonly project_reach?: "person";
    readonly placement_relation?: PlacementRelationDeclaration;
    readonly subject_offer_choices?: readonly SubjectOfferChoice[];
    readonly fragment_offer_choices?: readonly FragmentOfferChoice[];

    readonly required_actions?: readonly ActionReference[];

        readonly id: string;
        readonly revision?: string;
    };
    readonly background_job?: {
        readonly status: {
            readonly capability_id: string;
            readonly version: number;
        };
        readonly id: string;
        readonly input: string;
        readonly state: string;
        readonly done: readonly string[];
        readonly failed: readonly string[];
    };
    readonly undo?: {
        readonly capability_id: string;
        readonly version: number;
        readonly input: Readonly<Record<string, string | readonly [string]>>;
    };
}

        input: unknown;

        state?: unknown;

                            properties: {
                                surface: {
                                    pattern: string;

export interface FragmentActionOffer {
    readonly offer_id: string;
    readonly title: string;
    readonly action: ActionReference;
    readonly input: unknown;
    readonly summary?: string;
    readonly editable?: readonly string[];
    readonly missing?: readonly {

    }[];

export type FragmentApply = "result" | "replace" | "insert_after" | "record";

export type FragmentGranularity = (typeof FRAGMENT_GRANULARITIES)[number];

export type FragmentIntent = (typeof FRAGMENT_INTENTS)[number]["id"];

export interface FragmentOfferChoice {
    readonly offer_id: string;
    readonly title: string;
    readonly intent: FragmentIntent;
    readonly apply: FragmentApply;
    readonly hint: string;
    readonly action: Pick<ActionReference, "capability_id" | "version">;
    readonly granularities?: readonly FragmentGranularity[];
    readonly roles?: readonly FragmentRole[];
    readonly requires?: readonly "goal"[];
    readonly places?: readonly SurfacePlace[];
}

export interface FragmentOffersInput {
    readonly fragment: {
        readonly object: {
            readonly kind: string;
            readonly id: string;
            readonly version?: string | number;
            readonly title?: string;
        };
        readonly granularity: FragmentGranularity;
        readonly targets: readonly FragmentTarget[];
        readonly heading_path?: readonly string[];
        readonly goal?: {
            readonly id: string;
            readonly title: string;
        };
    };
    readonly request_id: string;
}

export type FragmentRole = (typeof FRAGMENT_ROLES)[number];

export interface FragmentTarget {
    readonly kind: "text_range" | "block" | "object";
    readonly role?: FragmentRole;
    readonly ref?: {
        readonly kind: string;
        readonly id: string;
        readonly version?: string | number;
        readonly title?: string;
    };
    readonly text: string;
    readonly truncated?: boolean;
}

            };
        };
    } | {
        properties: {
            kind: {
                enum: string[];
                const?: undefined;
            };
            id: {
                minLength: number;
                type: string;
            };
        };
    })[];
};

export interface WorkExecutorCalls {
    state: {
        input: Record<string, never>;
        output: WorkExecutorState;
    };

        input: WorkExecutorSessionOpen;
        output: WorkExecutorSessionRef;
    };
    "session.read": {
        input: WorkExecutorSessionReadInput;
        output: WorkExecutorSession;
    };
    "session.update": {
        input: WorkExecutorSessionUpdate;
        output: WorkExecutorSessionUpdate;
    };
    "run.start": {
        input: WorkExecutorRunStart;
        output: WorkExecutorRunStarted;
    };
    "run.control": {
        input: WorkExecutorRunControl;
        output: WorkExecutorRunControlResult;
    };
}

// Declarations the exports above refer to, which no entry exports itself:

interface DestinationDeclaration {
    readonly title: string;
    readonly verb: string;
    readonly describe: string;
    readonly material_field?: string;
    readonly prepare?: Pick<ActionReference, "capability_id" | "version">;
    readonly places?: readonly SurfacePlace[];
}

type RoundRef = {
    session_id: string;
    run_id: string;
};

interface WorkflowStationSpec {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    icon: string;
    create?: boolean;
    subject_kind: string;
    read_permissions: readonly string[];
    write_permissions: readonly string[];
    receive_scheduling?: "concurrent";
}
